lines.en: I come over with a trident on my shoulder.
I plant each step, water to my knees.
I head for the altar.
I circle a pillar once.
I retreat with the trident's points toward you.
I drag my feet, and the water sounds.
I come around the coral.
I climb the ruin's steps.
I keep low and close in.
I take my place beside my kin.
I shift for a better angle.
I turn broadside, slowly.

lines.zh: 我把戟尖在石上磨了磨。
lines.en: I whet the trident's point on stone.

lines.zh: 水面照出我肩上的鳞甲。
lines.en: The water shows me the scales on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我把长枪握在手里，很紧。
lines.en: I hold the spear tight.
I count the altar's steps.
I grip my shaft and wait for the word.
Seaweed clings to my armor.
I raise a hand for my kin to fall back.
I switch the trident to my other hand.

lines.zh: 我在听水里有没有别的动静。
lines.en: I listen for other sounds.
I remember the last fight.

lines.zh: 我把腕子转了一圈，试试。
lines.en: I roll my wrist once to test it.
I stand the spear upright beside me.
You carry no pearls.

lines.zh: 我认得这个姿势，你要打。
lines.en: I know that stance; you mean to fight.
My trident is longer than your sword.

lines.zh: 再往前，我的戟就顶住你。
lines.en: One more step and my trident is against you.

lines.zh: 你把武器放下，我们再谈。
lines.en: Set the weapon down and we'll talk.
You've hurt our kin.

lines.zh: 我站在祭坛前面，不让你过。
lines.en: I stand before the altar; you don't pass.
Your armor has a gap; I see it.
It didn't have to come to this.
I raise the trident only as warning.

lines.zh: 水里的仗我打过很多次。
lines.en: I've fought many battles in water.
Leave the steps and I hold.
I give half a step, trident still up.
A dent in my shoulder plate.
I grit my teeth and hold.
That landed on my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我把戟换到完好的那只手。
lines.en: I switch the trident to my good hand.
I make no sound; I only step back.
I press behind the pillar to breathe.
My bracer splits; I switch hands on the trident.
I raise my head and keep watching.
I'm still on my feet; be careful.
You're advancing; I wait.
You raised a hand; I move first.
You've raised the shield; better still.
I know this angle.
I wait for your foot to come in.
Your armor is new.
Your hand shakes; I'm counting it.
No one else will come down here.
I shift one step your way.
Listen; my trident rings.
You hit my trident's shaft and recoil.

lines.zh: 我往前顶了一步，你没让开。
lines.en: I press forward; you didn't give way.
We collide, and the water churns.
I hold the shaft across to keep you off.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You step on my foot; I don't budge.
I step back and raise the trident again.
Your shield scrapes my armor.
I turn, the points toward you.
We part, sand all around.
One push, and you give two steps.
Another knight stands on the steps.
Her trident is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把戟交叉，算作问候。
lines.en: We cross tridents in greeting.
She watches the east for me.
We guard the altar together.
Her armor bears old marks.
She hands me the whetstone.
We don't speak; each takes a side.
Seaweed clings to her spear.
Two of us, one trident, one altar.

lines.zh: 我把投出去的戟捡回来。
lines.en: I retrieve the trident I threw.

lines.zh: 我拾起掉在地上的长枪。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen spear.
I pick up the pearl that rolled here.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的盾拖进水里。
lines.en: I drag your dropped shield into the water.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块碎瓦，放回原处。
lines.en: I pick up a shard and put it back.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的戟杆捡起来。
lines.en: I pick up the snapped shaft.
I kick the old coin aside.

lines.zh: 我把你的箭从沙里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull your arrow from the sand.
I pick up my kin's bracer.

lines.zh: 我把海草从戟上扯下来。
lines.en: I tear the seaweed off my trident.
You hurt my kin; I remember.
I raise the trident and level it at you.
You're too near the altar.
I pick a place from which to throw.
Retreating up the steps won't help.
The trident is honed; you came at a good moment.
I signal my kin to fall back.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁在水里发亮。
lines.en: Your iron glints underwater.
I begin pressing forward.
Three counts, then you should be gone.
The water is my ground.
Your face is filed away beneath my scales.
The points face your chest.
I don't shout; it would carry upward.
I press in, step by step.
You go left; I swing the trident over.
I've measured the throwing range.
Your shield is too far forward.
I take the stone steps and circle lower.
I wait for you to misstep.
I raise a hand as if to throw.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，戟尖就跟一步。
lines.en: Every step you give, my trident follows.
The current runs my way.

lines.zh: 我的同伙在你的另一边。
lines.en: My kin are on your other side.
I lower the points a little.
Your breathing pattern gives you away.
I wait for the half-beat when you breathe.
The wall behind you is too close.
I'm not hurried; you can't retreat fast.
I throw the trident, fast.

lines.zh: 三叉扎在你的盾上，卡住了。
lines.en: The tines catch in your shield.
I can't pull it free and bite instead.
I sweep the shaft across.
I thrust at your knee.
That thrust came out of the water.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的盾边，往下压。
lines.en: I grip your shield's rim and press down.
I pull back to fetch my trident.
I drive my shoulder in.
It parries; I change angle.
One sweep of my shaft and the water turns to mud.
That thrust left a mark on your plate.
Weapon gone, I go in with teeth.
We close, shafts braced against each other.
I pin it on the steps.
It retreats; I go for the trident.

lines.zh: 我从祭坛后面的暗处出来。
lines.en: I come out of the dark behind the altar.
I pull the trident from the sand.
Someone needs to keep this place.
I heard someone enter the water above.
I stand mid-steps and hold.
My armor still drips.
I raise the trident toward the entrance.
My people asked me to watch this part.
I walk over slowly, heavy.

lines.zh: 水里多了个陌生的味道。
lines.en: A stranger's scent is in the water.
I stand the spear beside me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看水面的裂口。
lines.en: I glance at the gap in the surface.
Fire in the water; I leap back.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，戟脱手。
lines.en: I fall from the steps, the trident gone from my hand.

lines.zh: 我在水里也会呛，胸口发闷。
lines.en: Even I choke here; my chest tightens.

lines.zh: 爆炸把台阶掀了，我抓住柱子。
lines.en: The blast tears the steps; I catch the pillar.
An arrow sticks in my armor's seam.
A light presses my arm down.
I've stood guard hungry for a long while.
Lightning strikes the water; my hands go numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有台阶。
lines.en: No water here, and no steps.
